name: exclusivity-life
description: Workspace runner for the Exclusivity Life apps (goals, learning, nourishment, social, wealth)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:goals && npm run install:learning && npm run install:nourishment && npm run install:social && npm run install:wealth
scripts.install:learning: npm --prefix packages/learning install --install-links=false && npm --prefix packages/learning/electron install --install-links=false
scripts.test: npm run test:goals && npm run test:learning && npm run test:social
